_ai_assisted: Generated with Codex from Javi's draft and the team treatment guide; human review pending.
_integration_status: Activated for confirmed numerical findings. Immediate clinical-priority entry before measurement confirmation remains a separate owner integration; no numerical finding automatically establishes urgency.

w_intro.text: Your muscle readings need follow-up, and fatigue or weakness can have other causes. This app guides you; it does not diagnose.
w_intro.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; Team triage guide, muscle atrophy, watch [P]

w_red_flags.text: Do you have any of these right now: sudden or quickly worsening weakness, a new inability to move safely or to complete egress, or new intense muscle pain?
w_red_flags.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; Team triage guide, muscle atrophy, medical urgency [P]

w_report.text: Tell the crew medical officer. Review together your symptoms, any pain, your real exercise load and your strength trend.
w_report.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; Team triage guide, muscle atrophy, watch: initial action [P]

w_limits.text: Is the worsening unexpected, or does it stop you from completing a task?
w_limits.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; Team triage guide, muscle atrophy, watch: initial action [P]

w_priority_local.text: Ask the crew medical officer for a priority assessment using the pre-authorized local protocol. Earth cannot answer immediately from Mars.
w_priority_local.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; Team triage guide, muscle atrophy, watch [P]; NASA, Hazard: Distance From Earth [7]

w_priority_ground.text: Ask the flight surgeons for a priority assessment.
w_priority_ground.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; Team triage guide, muscle atrophy, watch: initial action [P]

w_exercise.text: Do not increase exercise load on your own after a strength drop. Review load, technique and recovery with your exercise specialist.
w_exercise.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; NASA, Exercise Overview [1]; Team triage guide [P]

w_nutrition.text: Review energy and protein intake with your approved nutrition plan. Do not start supplements or medicines without medical advice.
w_nutrition.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; NASA, Human Adaptation to Spaceflight: The Role of Nutrition [2]; Team triage guide [P]

w_avoid.text: Do not train with pain, and do not make up missed sessions with extra load.
w_avoid.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; Team triage guide, muscle atrophy, watch: avoid [P]

w_end.text: Log symptoms and training daily, and repeat the comparable strength test when indicated. Follow your prescribed rehabilitation after return.
w_end.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; NASA, The Real Story About Astronaut Health Care in Space [3]; Canadian Space Agency, Return and Reconditioning [4]

u_stop.text: Stop exercise and risky tasks, get to a safe position and alert the crew medical officer immediately. Do not repeat maximal tests or wait for another sensor reading.
u_stop.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; Team triage guide, muscle atrophy, medical urgency: initial action [P]

u_orbit.text: Notify the flight surgeons and continue care with the crew medical officer. Any return decision belongs to the medical and mission team.
u_orbit.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; Team triage guide, by environment [P]; NASA, The Real Story About Astronaut Health Care in Space [3]

u_moon.text: Notify the flight surgeons while care starts in the habitat. Transfer depends on the vehicle, resources and clinical decision.
u_moon.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; Team triage guide, by environment [P]

u_mars_send.text: Transmit the case to Earth and follow the pre-authorized local protocol with the crew medical officer. Do not wait for an immediate reply.
u_mars_send.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; Team triage guide, by environment [P]; NASA, Hazard: Distance From Earth [7]

u_ground.text: Notify the flight surgeons and continue local medical care.
u_ground.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; Team triage guide, medical urgency [P]

u_end.text: Clinical review and handover have been acknowledged. Stay assisted and follow the clinician's restrictions and rehabilitation plan.
u_end.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; Team triage guide, muscle atrophy, medical urgency: follow-up [P]

u_help.text: Request immediate assistance from the crew medical officer. Do not continue the risky task.

u_reviewed.text: Has a clinician reviewed this episode and accepted the handover?
u_reviewed.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; keep urgency active until clinical review [P]. Prototype acknowledgement, not identity verification.

u_wait_review.text: Stay assisted and continue the local medical instructions. Keep this episode open until clinical review and accepted handover.
u_wait_review.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; clinical review before closure [P]. No timed wait is prescribed.

w_concern.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), pp. 1-2; numerical concern requires priority review without automatic medical urgency [P].

w_priority_review.text: Ask the crew medical officer for priority medical review of the concerning finding. A concerning number alone does not establish a medical urgency.
